content: uv has Tier 1 (guaranteed) support for Python 3.14 and is Astral's recommended replacement for pip-tools; use 'uv pip compile requirements.in -o requirements.txt' or a uv.lock (uv add/uv sync) for locking, and 'uv sync --locked --no-dev' in Docker/CI to install exactly the locked prod deps reproducibly. uv is 10-100x faster than pip for installs, has native Docker integration guides (docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/integration/docker), and using it consistently in both CI and Docker (vs pip in one place, uv in another) avoids dependency-drift incidents.
